understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid to complete each level by stepping onto every goal cell only when the carried piece exactly matches that goal’s required shape, color, and rotation; completing all goals advances levels, and finishing all levels wins.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs 1 stamina; when stamina hits 0 you lose 1 life and stamina resets to max, and losing all lives ends the game. Movement is constrained by walls and the provided blocked_directions (attempting a blocked direction wastes the move). Stepping on modifier tiles changes the carried piece: shape tiles cycle shapes 0–5 (wrap), color tiles cycle orange→blue→green→red→orange (wrap), and rotation tiles rotate 90° clockwise (0→90→180→270→0). A goal activates and can be completed only when shape, color, and rotation all match simultaneously; then stepping onto the goal cell completes it.
